resources.string: Shows a floating button. Tap: Back. Drag: move it. Long press: hide it for a few seconds. Swipe mode and other settings are in the OneBack app. Cannot read screen content.
The button is off. Switch on \"OneBack floating back button\" in the accessibility settings.
Changes apply to the button right away.
Move button back to default position
Use the OneBack button to go back to the settings.\n\nIf that doesn\'t work, tap the arrow at the top left.
Tap: Back. Drag: move it. Long press: hide it. Hidden in landscape.
Swipe starting on the button (any direction): Back. Tap: nothing. Long press, then drag: move it. Long press and release: hide it. Hidden in landscape.
